# Product hero — Style Prompt

> The object is the hero and never leaves the stage. It drops in from above and bounces to rest under a fan of slowly turning rays, a round badge spins on beside it, and from then on only the words beneath it change: the name and its qualities, the old price struck and the new one counted up, a pill to act on. One object, one light, captions taking turns below it.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is a **pedestal**. One object stands centred in the upper half (420 × 660 at 1080 wide, resting at about y 1100), lit from behind by rays, and floats 24 px up and down for the whole film. Everything that changes happens in the caption zone under it (y 1170 to 1640): first a one-line promise and the name with three feature chips, then the price, then the call to action. The drop is the hook; the object's constant presence is the point. Whatever the caption says, the viewer is looking at the thing.

Not a catalogue (one object, never a grid), not a turntable (it tilts 14° only while falling, then floats upright), not a slideshow (the object never cuts away), not a sale banner (one price, one button, no bursts or tickers).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **The room**: the background with a large elliptical pool of the second surface behind the object (radial 120 % × 70 % at 50 % 38 %), so it stands in light rather than on a flat colour.
- **The rays**: one 2000 px square of `repeating-conic-gradient`, an 8° wedge of the main colour at 16 % every 22°, faded to nothing at 60 % of its radius with a radial mask and set at 50 % opacity. Drawn once and only rotated and scaled: it carries `will-change: transform`, without which the live preview repaints this large masked layer every frame and drops to half speed on a slow phone.
- **The object**: flat vector shapes. A dark cap with a lighter band, a glass body with a three-stop horizontal gradient mixed from one product colour toward black (73 %, 100 %, 67 %), a paper label carrying the name, one vertical highlight bar at 25 %. Under it, a soft elliptical floor shadow (400 × 60, black at 55 % fading out). In a real video the user's product photo, cut out, takes its place on the same pedestal.
- **The badge**: a 220 px disc in the main colour with two short uppercase words on two lines.
- **Chips**: outline pills, a 3 px border of the text colour at 40 %, radius 60.
- **The price**: the old price with a 7 px strike bar in the accent, the new price large in the main colour.
- **The pill**: a wide button (860 × 150, radius 80) in the accent colour carrying the action and the contact on one line.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the room; `--latar-2`: the pool of light behind the object.
- `--utama`: the light and what it falls on: the rays, the badge, the promise above the name, the new price.
- `--teks-di-utama`: the badge's words.
- `--aksen`: the action: the strike through the old price and the pill. Text on the pill is `--teks-di-aksen`, derived from the accent's lightness (near-black above OKLCH L 0.68, white below), because a brand may set any accent.
- `--teks`: the business name at the top, the product name, the chips. `--teks-redup`: the old price.
- Fixed: the object's own colours (`--produk`, `--tutup`, `--label`, `--label-tinta`) and `--bayangan` for its shading and floor shadow. Packaging does not recolour with the brand; set these to the real product's colours when you draw it.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the product name and the price: a heavy, wide display face (Archivo Black by default; Poppins 800 holds at the same size, a condensed face such as Bebas Neue looks thin here unless set about 1.3× larger). Name 96 px on one line, letter-spacing −2 px, line box 1.1; new price 160 px.
- `--font-isi` carries everything else, Poppins by default: the business name 46 px 800 uppercase with letter-spacing 8 px, the badge 48 px 800, the promise 46 px 500, chips 44 px 500, the old price 70 px 500, the pill 46 px 800.
- The name is one line (816 px of the 920 px safe width at 96 px); the promise above it is one short sentence; chips are two or three words each.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Drop**: the object falls from y −1100 tilted −14° to rest in 0.9 s `bounce.out`; the floor shadow grows from scale 0.2 with the same ease, so it lands with the object.
- **Float**: y 0 ↔ −24 px, 1.4 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, from 1.2 s to 13.8 s.
- **Rays**: rotate 0 → 40° and scale 0.6 → 1 over the whole 15 s, linear.
- **Business name**: drops 40 px with a fade, 0.6 s `power3.out`.
- **Badge**: from scale 0 and −90° to rest, 0.6 s `back.out(2)`, then sways 0 ↔ 12° (0.8 s `sine.inOut`, eight swings).
- **Name**: each line rises through its mask (`yPercent: 110 → 0`), 0.65 s `expo.out`, staggered 0.15 s.
- **Chips**: from 60 px lower, scale 0.8 and transparent, 0.5 s `back.out(1.7)`, staggered 0.18 s.
- **Caption out**: up 60 px with a fade, 0.45 s `power2.in`, staggered 0.06 s.
- **Price**: the old price rises 40 px (0.5 s `power3.out`); 0.6 s later the strike draws from the left (`scaleX: 0 → 1`, 0.45 s `power2.inOut`); then the new price pops from scale 0.5 (0.5 s `back.out(1.8)`) while it counts 0 → 25.000 in steps of 1.000 over 1 s `power2.out`, and pumps to 1.1 and back (0.18 s each way).
- **Pill**: rises 220 px with a fade, 0.7 s `expo.out`, then breathes to 1.05 (0.45 s `sine.inOut`, three breaths); price and pill hold together about 4 s, and the film fades out over the last 0.5 s.
- Holds: the name and chips read still for about 3 s (from 3.5 s, when the last chip lands, to 6.6 s).

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked off on the pedestal. The object moves; the frame never does.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Drop and bounce | arrival, "here it is" | a new product, a book on release day, the object of an episode, a gift |
| Float | alive, precious | the whole film, under any caption |
| Rays turning behind | spotlight, celebration | a launch, a winner, the best of a list |
| Badge spin-in | a label on the moment | new, limited, best seller, part 2 |
| Caption swap under the object | the next thing to know | name, then qualities, then price, then how to get it |
| Strike and count-up | value, the deal | a price, pages, minutes of content, members |

## 7. Native moves

- **The drop.** The object falls into the frame, bounces to rest and its shadow lands with it. *Fits content like:* a jar of sambal from a home kitchen; a creator's new merch tee; a novel's cover on publication day; the tool of the week in a review channel.
- **Spotlight rays.** A slow fan of light turns behind the object for the whole film. *Fits content like:* a bakery's cake of the month; an award or a milestone plaque; a course certificate; the trophy at the end of a short story.
- **Spinning badge.** A disc in the main colour spins on beside the object and sways. *Fits content like:* "BARU RILIS"; "EDISI TERBATAS"; "PART 2"; "GRATIS ONGKIR".
- **Name and chips.** The name rises through a mask under the object, then three outline chips pop in. *Fits content like:* "Tanpa pengawet / Tahan 2 bulan / Botol 200 gr"; "120 halaman / Full warna / Bonus stiker"; "8 modul / Sertifikat / Akses selamanya"; "Bab 1 / 12 menit / Baca gratis".
- **Struck and counted.** The old figure is struck through, the new one counts up and pumps. *Fits content like:* a price cut; "Rp99.000 → Rp49.000" for a class; "3 jam → 30 menit" for a tutorial's promise; a pre-order price.
- **Pill under the pedestal.** A wide pill with the action and the contact rises and breathes while the object keeps floating. *Fits content like:* "Pesan sekarang · chat 0812-3456-7890"; "Link di bio"; "Daftar kelas"; "Baca bab 1 gratis".

## 8. Pitfalls

- Moving the object off its pedestal (cutting away, sliding it across) breaks the look. Change only the captions.
- A long name at 96 px overflows the 920 px safe width: keep it to about 14 characters or set it smaller. Never let it wrap inside a one-line mask, the mask clips the second line.
- Captions creeping up into the object: keep caption tops at y 1170 or lower so the float never touches them.
- Text on the pill in `--teks` instead of `--teks-di-aksen` disappears on a light accent.
- In this example the second row of chips and the pill reach y 1640, inside the bottom 420 px that short-video apps cover with buttons and captions: for those apps, raise the stage and the captions about 100 px, keep the chips to one row, and make the pill 120 px tall, so they end above y 1500.
- Only the object, the rays, the badge and the pill move while words are read; captions hold still.
- More light is not better: one composited conic gradient (`will-change: transform`) is cheap to rotate, but dropping `will-change`, blurring the glow or stacking several ray layers slows the preview.

# Product hero: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 3.

## hook

- en: the subject drops in and bounces under turning rays, a badge spins on beside it
- id: subjek jatuh dan memantul di bawah sinar berputar, badge berputar masuk di sampingnya

## problem

- en: the subject dims, the problem appears as a caption below it
- id: subjek meredup, masalah muncul sebagai teks di bawahnya

## fact

- en: the subject floats, one caption rises below it through a mask
- id: subjek melayang, satu keterangan naik dari balik masker di bawahnya

## step

- en: the subject stays, a numbered caption swaps below it per step
- id: subjek tetap, keterangan bernomor berganti di bawahnya tiap langkah

## compare

- en: objects slide side by side under one light
- id: objek bergeser berjajar di bawah satu cahaya

## number

- en: old figure struck through, the new one counts up and pumps under the subject
- id: angka lama dicoret, angka baru dihitung naik lalu menghentak di bawah subjek

## proof

- en: a small badge spins on beside the subject with the claim
- id: badge kecil berputar masuk di samping subjek membawa klaimnya

## offer

- en: the name rises through a mask under the subject, feature chips pop in
- id: nama naik dari balik masker di bawah subjek, chip keunggulan bermunculan

## cta

- en: a pill with the action and contact rises under the subject and breathes, held 2 s
- id: pill ajakan + kontak naik di bawah subjek lalu bernapas, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the subject in full light, the name settles below it, held 2 s
- id: subjek dalam cahaya penuh, nama mendarat di bawahnya, diam 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Produk utama</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Sesudahnya milik tampilan ini:
         teks di atas warna aksen (hitam atau putih mengikuti terang aksen, karena brand bisa menggantinya),
         lalu warna kemasan produk dan bayangan, yang tidak ikut warna brand. */
      :root {
        --latar: #2a0a0a; --latar-2: #5c1010; --utama: #ffc93c; --aksen: #ff3b30;
        --teks: #fff6ee; --teks-redup: #c7b0aa; --teks-di-utama: #2a0a0a;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #ffc93c; --aksen-di-latar: #ff3b30;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --produk: #d6301f; --tutup: #1d1d1d; --label: #fff6ee; --label-tinta: #2a0a0a; --bayangan: #000000;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); background: radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 38%, var(--latar-2), var(--latar) 70%); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Sinar: kerucut berulang, dipudarkan ke tepi dengan mask. will-change: digambar sekali lalu hanya digerakkan,
         tanpa itu pratinjau menggambar ulang lapisan besar ini setiap frame. */
      .rays { position: absolute; left: -460px; top: -280px; width: 2000px; height: 2000px; opacity: 0.5; will-change: transform;
        background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 16%, transparent) 0deg 8deg, transparent 8deg 22deg);
        -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 0%, transparent 60%); mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, black 0%, transparent 60%); }
      .usaha { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 230px; text-align: center; font-size: 46px; font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.9; }
      .stage { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 380px; height: 760px; }
      .shadow { position: absolute; left: 340px; top: 690px; width: 400px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayangan) 55%, transparent), transparent); }
      .jar { position: absolute; left: 330px; top: 60px; width: 420px; height: 660px; }
      .jar .kaca-tepi { stop-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--produk) 73%, var(--bayangan)); }
      .jar .kaca-tengah { stop-color: var(--produk); }
      .jar .kaca-gelap { stop-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--produk) 67%, var(--bayangan)); }
      .jar .tutup { fill: var(--tutup); }
      .jar .cincin { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tutup) 88%, var(--label)); }
      .jar .label { fill: var(--label); }
      .jar .kilau { fill: var(--label); opacity: 0.25; }
      .jar text { text-anchor: middle; }
      .jar .l1 { font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 56px; fill: var(--label-tinta); }
      .jar .l2 { font-family: "Poppins"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 44px; fill: var(--produk); }
      .jar .l3 { font-family: "Poppins"; font-weight: 500; font-size: 24px; fill: var(--label-tinta); }
      .badge { position: absolute; right: 110px; top: 300px; width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        text-align: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 48px; line-height: 1; }
      .title { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1170px; text-align: center; }
      .title .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .title .line span { display: inline-block; }
      .kecil { font-size: 46px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .besar { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 96px; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; }
      .chips { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1400px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 22px; justify-content: center; }
      .chip { padding: 18px 34px; border-radius: 60px; border: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 40%, transparent);
        font-size: 44px; font-weight: 500; }
      .price { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1180px; text-align: center; }
      .coret { position: relative; display: inline-block; font-size: 70px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .coret i { position: absolute; left: -8px; right: -8px; top: 50%; height: 7px; background: var(--aksen); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .now { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 160px; line-height: 1.05; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .cta { position: absolute; left: 110px; right: 110px; top: 1490px; height: 150px; border-radius: 80px;
        background: var(--aksen); color: var(--teks-di-aksen);
        display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 46px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="rays" id="rays"></div>

      <!-- Pembuka: produk jatuh ke panggung dan tetap di sana sampai akhir. -->
      <div class="scene" id="hero" data-role="hook">
        <div class="usaha" id="usaha">Dapur Bu Rini</div>
        <div class="stage" id="stage">
          <div class="shadow" id="shadow"></div>
          <!-- Produk digambar dengan SVG: bentuk sederhana, label berisi nama. Ganti dengan foto produk pengguna bila ada. -->
          <svg class="jar" id="jar" viewBox="0 0 420 660">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="kaca" x1="0" x2="1">
                <stop offset="0" class="kaca-tepi" /><stop offset="0.5" class="kaca-tengah" /><stop offset="1" class="kaca-gelap" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <rect class="tutup" x="70" y="20" width="280" height="110" rx="24" />
            <rect class="cincin" x="70" y="100" width="280" height="22" />
            <path d="M60 140 h300 q30 0 30 40 v400 q0 60 -60 60 h-240 q-60 0 -60 -60 v-400 q0 -40 30 -40z" fill="url(#kaca)" />
            <rect class="label" x="60" y="280" width="300" height="230" />
            <text class="l1" x="210" y="370">SAMBAL</text>
            <text class="l2" x="210" y="440">BAWANG</text>
            <text class="l3" x="210" y="485">level pedas 5</text>
            <rect class="kilau" x="95" y="170" width="26" height="380" rx="13" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="badge" id="badge">BARU<br />RILIS</div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="kenalan" data-role="offer">
        <div class="title" id="title">
          <span class="line"><span class="kecil">Pedasnya nampol, wanginya juara</span></span>
          <span class="line"><span class="besar">Sambal Bawang</span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="chips" id="chips">
          <div class="chip">Tanpa pengawet</div>
          <div class="chip">Tahan 2 bulan</div>
          <div class="chip">Botol 200 gr</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="price" id="price" data-role="number">
        <div class="coret">Rp35.000<i id="garis"></i></div>
        <div class="now" id="now">Rp25.000</div>
      </div>

      <div class="cta" id="cta" data-role="cta">Pesan sekarang · 0812-3456-7890</div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      tl.fromTo("#rays", { rotation: 0, scale: 0.6 }, { rotation: 40, scale: 1, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .from("#usaha", { y: -40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2)
        // Produk jatuh dan memantul, bayangan ikut mengecil-membesar.
        .from("#jar", { y: -1100, rotation: -14, duration: 0.9, ease: "bounce.out" }, 0.1)
        .from("#shadow", { scale: 0.2, opacity: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: "bounce.out" }, 0.1)
        .from("#badge", { scale: 0, rotation: -90, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 1.0)
        .to("#badge", { rotation: 12, duration: 0.8, yoyo: true, repeat: 7, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 1.6)
        // Produk melayang pelan selama video.
        .to("#jar", { y: -24, duration: 1.4, yoyo: true, repeat: 8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 1.2)
        // Nama naik dari balik masker, lalu chip keunggulan bermunculan.
        .from(".title .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.65, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.15 }, 1.3)
        .from(".chip", { y: 60, opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.7)", stagger: 0.18 }, 2.6)
        .to(["#title", "#chips"], { y: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.in", stagger: 0.06 }, 6.6);

      // Harga: harga lama dicoret, harga baru dihitung naik lalu menghentak.
      const harga = { v: 0 };
      const now = document.getElementById("now");
      tl.from(".coret", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 7.1)
        .from("#garis", { scaleX: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 7.7)
        .from("#now", { scale: 0.5, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 8.0)
        .to(harga, {
          v: 25000, duration: 1, ease: "power2.out",
          onUpdate: () => { now.textContent = "Rp" + (Math.round(harga.v / 1000) * 1000).toLocaleString("id-ID"); },
        }, 8.0)
        .to("#now", { scale: 1.1, duration: 0.18, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.out" }, 9.0)
        // Penutup: tombol naik, bernapas pelan, lalu semuanya diam sampai memudar.
        .from("#cta", { y: 220, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 9.6)
        .to("#cta", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 10.6)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      tl.fromTo("#rays", { rotation: 0, scale: 0.6 }, { rotation: 40, scale: 1, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .from("#usaha", { y: -40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2)
        // Produk jatuh dan memantul, bayangan ikut mengecil-membesar.
        .from("#jar", { y: -1100, rotation: -14, duration: 0.9, ease: "bounce.out" }, 0.1)
        .from("#shadow", { scale: 0.2, opacity: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: "bounce.out" }, 0.1)
        .from("#badge", { scale: 0, rotation: -90, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 1.0)
        .to("#badge", { rotation: 12, duration: 0.8, yoyo: true, repeat: 7, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 1.6)
        // Produk melayang pelan selama video.

        .to(["#title", "#chips"], { y: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.in", stagger: 0.06 }, 6.6);

      // Harga: harga lama dicoret, harga baru dihitung naik lalu menghentak.
      const harga = { v: 0 };
      const now = document.getElementById("now");
      tl.from(".coret", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 7.1)

        .to(harga, {

          onUpdate: () => { now.textContent = "Rp" + (Math.round(harga.v / 1000) * 1000).toLocaleString("id-ID"); },
